<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the [M + H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The combination of atoms that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₈H₁₄NO (96 + 14.1096 + 14.0031 + 15.9949 ≈ 140.108 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C8H14NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14NO</final_answer>
